name: Camping Seeblick Toni
beschreibung: The campsite Seeblick Toni is located in Kramsach directly on the shore of Lake Reintaler See. The location allows direct access to the water and panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. The site has level pitches for caravans and motorhomes as well as full utility hookups. Proximity to the lake provides wonderful opportunities for swimming and watersports, while the village of Kramsach offers shops and restaurants nearby.
